name: French Classical — Main Line
description: The classical French Defense with 3.Nc3 Nf6. Leads to rich maneuvering battles where Black often strikes with ...c5 or ...f6.

lines.name: Classical Variation — Main Line
lines.description: White develops the knight to c3 and pins with Bg5. Black develops solidly with Be7. The e5 pawn gives White space, but Black has a solid structure and counter-attacking chances on the queenside.
